items.title: High-Density Geometric Interlocking Maze CNC Grid
items.description: Enhance your custom interior projects with this high-density geometric interlocking mesh grid, offering a sophisticated, almost maze-like visual complexity. Flawlessly prepared in clean DXF, SVG, and DWG vector formats, this precise structural pattern is optimized for efficient high-volume laser cutting and CNC wood carving. Ideal for manufacturing modern privacy room dividers, office screens, and architectural ceiling grid panels with a high percentage of ventilation and light filtration.
